scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --out-dir pkg-production --no-pack -- --target-dir target/wasm-production --locked
scripts.build:wasm:dev: wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --out-dir pkg-production --no-pack --dev -- --target-dir target/wasm-production
scripts.build:wasm:playground: wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --out-dir pkg-playground --no-pack -- --target-dir target/wasm-playground --features playground
scripts.build:wasm:playground:dev: wasm-pack build crates/browser --target bundler --out-dir pkg-playground --no-pack --dev -- --target-dir target/wasm-playground --features playground
scripts.dev:rust: cargo-watch --postpone --watch crates/browser/src --watch crates/game/src --watch crates/protocol/src --watch crates/simulation/src -s 'npm run build:wasm:all:dev'
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm:all:dev && (npm run dev:rust & npm run dev:web)
scripts.build:wasm:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:playground
scripts.build:wasm:all:dev: npm run build:wasm:dev && npm run build:wasm:playground:dev
